title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Private DNS Resolver Forwarding Ruleset module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-privatednsresolverdnsforwardingruleset'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Azure Private DNS Resolver Forwarding Ruleset module

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

private_dns_resolver_outbound_endpoint_i.description: (Required) The list of IDs of the Private DNS Resolver Outbound Endpoints that are linked to the Private DNS Resolver Forwarding Ruleset.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Private DNS Forwarding Ruleset.

name.description: The Name of the Private DNS Forwarding Ruleset.

resource.description: The Private DNS Forwarding Ruleset resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Privatednsresolverdnsforwardingruleset' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
